supporting_pages.title: Generate TCO reports \_|\_ Migration Center \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: You can view your TCO report directly in Migration Center, or export it to Google Slides or Google Sheets, or download it as a CSV file or a Microsoft Excel spreadsheet.
Limitations If you generate a TCO report for a group that contains a database deployment and its underlying server, Migration Center generates separate cost estimates for the server and the database.
